No prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash null. Transfers gross from fund columns (General in 264,171, Sales Tax out 264,171; Total column nets to zero). Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (governmental funds balance sheet totals do not equal government-wide, which includes capital assets). General Fund detail from the departmental combining statement (p12), more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule (p9), which is not recorded to avoid double counting. Keno fund had no activity and no schedule. Utility funds have no budget schedule; detail from the proprietary statement fund columns (p7). Business-type disbursement total 345,557 printed on Statement of Activities p2. Read pages 1-12 of 12
